releases.name: opencode-go-statusline 1.1.1
releases.body:
### Changed

- Correct the README's requirements and `Go —` troubleshooting, name the config files that take the `language` option, and note that `cli.json` takes precedence.
- Re-record the README demo animation.

### Fixed

- Round quota percentages to whole numbers and clamp them to 0–100%.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

### 变更

- 修正 README 中的环境要求和 `Go —` 疑难排查，写明 `language` 选项所在的配置文件，并说明 `cli.json` 中的设置优先。
- 重新录制 README 演示动画。

### 修复

- 配额百分比取整，并限制在 0–100% 之间。

</details>

**Changelog**: Read [here](https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/blob/opencode-go-statusline%401.1.1/packages/opencode-go-statusline/CHANGELOG.md)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/compare/opencode-go-statusline%401.1.0...opencode-go-statusline%401.1.1

releases.name: opencode-go-statusline 1.1.0
releases.body:
### Changed

- Adapt the statusline to the terminal width: full labels and reset countdowns at 120+ columns, short labels (`5H`, `W`, `M`) at 80–119, the weekly window only below 80; expanding the footer details no longer forces the countdowns.

<details>
<summary>简体中文</summary>

### 变更

- 按终端宽度调整状态栏：≥ 120 列显示完整标签和重置倒计时，80–119 列使用短标签（`5H`、`W`、`M`），< 80 列只显示每周窗口；展开底栏详情不再强制显示倒计时。

</details>

**Changelog**: Read [here](https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/blob/opencode-go-statusline%401.1.0/packages/opencode-go-statusline/CHANGELOG.md)
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/lnwu/opencode-statusline-plugins/compare/opencode-go-statusline%401.0.4...opencode-go-statusline%401.1.0
